name: Titanic Passenger Survival
description: Mixed passenger attributes, substantial missingness, and a binary survival target.

license.name: Vanderbilt Biostatistics data permission
license.attribution: Data obtained from http://hbiostat.org/data courtesy of the Vanderbilt University Department of Biostatistics.

learning_goals: Compare imputation strategies for age, fare, cabin, and embarkation.
Inspect class balance and precision/recall trade-offs.
Recognize post-outcome leakage in boat and body fields.
ethical_notes: Historical passenger records include sex, age, and travel class. Use for teaching, not to generalize moral worth or modern safety policy.
